faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SPC Setup Packages. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.a: SPC (Sharjah Publishing City) Free Zone is a leading Free Zone in Sharjah, specially designed for publishing, media, education, and creative businesses. It offers low-cost setup, 100% foreign ownership, and quick licensing — typically within 3-7 working days.

items.q: What is included in the SPC setup package?
items.a: Depending on the package, you get the Free Zone license, residency visa, medical & Emirates ID, lease agreement, bank account assistance, premium address, and free VAT consultation.

items.q: How much does an SPC package cost?
items.a: Our SPC packages start from AED 5,999 (Economy) and go up to AED 16,999 (Mainland + Residency). Premium packages with visa start at AED 14,499.
Typically 3-7 working days for license issuance, and additional 1-2 weeks for visa processing and bank account opening.
Yes. All packages are starting points and can be customized to match your business activity, visa needs, and budget.

items.q: Do I get a UAE residency visa?
items.a: Yes, select packages include a UAE investor/residency visa with medical, Emirates ID, and status change. The Free Zone License with Lifetime UAE Residency even offers lifetime residency.
Yes. All packages include free assistance with corporate bank account opening at top UAE banks.

items.q: What business activities can I do?
items.a: SPC supports publishing, media, e-commerce, IT services, creative industries, and professional services — with up to 5 activities in most economy packages.

items.q: Do I need to be physically present?
items.a: Most steps can be done remotely, but medical tests and Emirates ID biometrics require a brief visit to the UAE.

items.q: Why choose Setup Zone Dubai for SPC setup?
items.a: We offer transparent pricing, fast processing, dedicated consultants, and end-to-end support — from license to visa to bank account. All with 10,000+ successful setups.
